sources.snippet: Haas-ja-v1.0, an open Japanese speech-recognition model from Third Intelligence, reports a 6.12% strict CER under Apache 2.0. What is confirmed.

sources.title: Haas-ja-v1.0: 6.12% CER Japanese Speech Model [2026]
sources.snippet: Third Intelligence has released Haas-ja-v1.0, an open Japanese speech recognition model built for fast, accurate transcription. In its release post, researcher Tatsu Matsushima wrote, “We have developed a new Japanese speech recognition model, Haas-ja-v1.0, and released it as open source!”, as GIGAZINE reported on November 2. The dated announcement puts the release on October 30, 2026.
